correctness.rationale: The source auxiliary problem has the unique minimizer \(Y=-ax\). Direct substitution gives Armijo exactly as \(\alpha a\le2(1-\beta)\) and curvature exactly as \(\alpha a\ge1-\gamma\). Necessity of \(a\ge1-\gamma\) on the source grid is immediate because every trial has \(\alpha\le1\). For sufficiency, if the unit step is too large, the first dyadic step below the Armijo ceiling is still larger than \(1-\beta>1-\gamma\). The two-sided grid works because the admissible scaled interval has multiplicative width strictly larger than two. The inspected verifier checks the algebra on a rational lattice but is not the proof.

final_claim: For the scalar robust quadratic \(\kappa(x)=\tfrac12ax^2\), the source standard Wolfe conditions hold exactly when \(1-\gamma\le \alpha a\le2(1-\beta)\); the printed one-sided dyadic grid contains an admissible step exactly when \(a\ge1-\gamma\), while a two-sided dyadic grid is scale-complete.
